decisions.question: Scaffolded as checkbox / radio (interactive: state axis has hover, focus, disabled; named "Radio"). Confirm, or re-run npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=radio --archetype=<link-card|card|collection>.
decisions.chose: checkbox / radio — interactive: state axis has hover, focus, disabled; named "Radio"
alternatives: link-card: A card that is one link: illustration or icon, a headline, optional description, an arrow affordance. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name.
card: A non-interactive content card; actions live in a slot.
collection: A row, grid or scroller of one repeated unit.
button: Triggers an action. A label, optional leading and trailing icons, and the full interactive state set.
toggle / switch: A binary on/off control that applies immediately.
input / field: Accepts typed input. Label, value, placeholder, and an error state.
badge / tag / chip: A small label. Non-interactive unless it is dismissible.
pagination: Moves between pages of content.
accordion: A disclosure: a trigger that shows and hides a region of content. Open or closed is a prop a consumer sets, not an interaction state.
select / dropdown: A choice among options. The native <select> does the choosing; the design styles the trigger around it.
helper text: Guidance or a message under a field: hint, error, success. Associated with its field, never floating.
list: A sequence of like items — features, links, steps. The items are the content; the list is the rhythm.
decisions.evidence: decided by heuristic; token namespaces content×2; state axis default/hover/focus/disabled

decisions.question: disabled, name, value exist in the component but have no design counterpart. Confirm each is authored (lever true) or integration-only (lever false). "disabled" collides with the State axis, which this draft read as runtime states — decide whether the code prop or the state axis is the truth.
decisions.chose: added 3 code-only props as levers with no design binding
decisions.fix: Set lever:false on the integration-only ones, or delete any the component should stop accepting.

decisions.question: radio, ring, dot have no class of their own in radio.css. The design names these parts separately and the code does not. Split the class, or model them as one part.
decisions.chose: kept a derived selector that matches nothing
decisions.fix: Set anatomy.root.parts.<part>.selector to the real class, or add the class to radio.css.

decisions.question: Structural match says extend: closest existing contract is Logo (score 1). Extend it instead of adding a component?
decisions.chose: a new component, over extending Logo (match extend, score 1)
decisions.fix: If it is the same component, delete this draft and add a variant to Logo instead.
decisions.evidence: Logo (1) already covers this; extend it.
